liturgicalName: 3rd Sunday of Lent (Year A readings may be used)
keyVerseDR: "Lord, let it alone this year also, until I dig about it..." (Lk 13:8)

level1.title: Another Chance
level1.story: A man had a fig tree with no figs. He wanted to cut it down. The gardener said, "Give it one more year, and I will care for it." God gives us another chance!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did the gardener ask for?
What good fruit can you grow?
level1.prayer: God, thank You for another chance. Amen.

activity.title: Another chance
activity.intro: Stamp or draw a fig each day you do something good.

level2.title: The Barren Fig Tree
level2.story: Some people told Jesus about Galileans whom Pilate had killed. Jesus said, "Unless you shall do penance, you shall all likewise perish." Then He told a parable: a man had a fig tree in his vineyard, and for three years it bore no fruit. He said, "Cut it down therefore: why cumbereth it the ground?" The gardener said, "Lord, let it alone this year also, until I dig about it, and dung it," so that it may bear fruit.
level2.keyLine: Lord, let it alone this year also.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What 'fruit' should Lent produce in you?
level2.prayer: Lord, be patient with me and help me bear fruit. Amen.

activity.title: Time to grow
activity.intro: God gives us another chance. Check your heart this Lent.
items: Did I say sorry when I was wrong?
Is there someone I need to forgive?

art.mainBrief: Gardener tending a fig tree with no fruit
